title: Samudda
text: 2. Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yā kāci mahānadiyo || seyyatthīdaṃ Gaṅgā Yamunā Acīravatī Sarabhū Mahī || sabbā tā samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā || evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu- -nibbānapabbhāro || || 3. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu- a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto nibbānapoṇo nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapabbhāro ti || || Gaṅgāpeyyālo || || Tassa uddānam || || Cha pācīnato ninnā || Cha ninnā ca samuddato || Ete dve cha dvādasa honti || peyyālī tena vuccatī ti || || Gaṅgāpeyyalī pācīnaninnā pācīnamaggi || Vivekanissitaṃ dvādasakī paṭhamakī || || II. RĀGAVINAYA.
